name: Positive Message Crochet Animals (25 Pack)
seoTitle: Crochet Animal Gifts for a Nursing Team
metaDescription: A set of 25 small crochet animals with positive messages, made for handing out to a whole nursing team for Nurses Week, graduation, or a thank you.
summary: Twenty five small crochet animals, each with a positive message, made for thanking an entire unit at once.
bestFor: Nurses Week for a whole unit
whyItWorks: Finding a gift for an entire unit is harder than buying for one person. Food disappears in an hour and generic swag often ends up in a drawer. Small crochet animals with encouraging messages are different, because each nurse gets a little keepsake of their own. They are the kind of thing that ends up clipped near a workstation, sitting on a locker shelf, or riding along in a scrubs pocket on a hard night shift.

With 25 in the set, a nurse manager, charge nurse, or educator can cover a good sized team for Nurses Week, a unit milestone, or the end of a tough stretch like a staffing crunch or flu season. They also suit nursing school graduation or a pinning ceremony, where a class of students can each take one home. The positive messages do the talking, so a short card from you is all you need to add. Because each piece is handmade looking and cute, it feels warmer than a bulk order of pens.
goodToKnow: Check the listing to see whether the animals and messages are all different or repeat across the set.
Small crochet items may not be ideal for areas with strict infection control rules, so they are best kept in lockers, break rooms, or at home.
Count your team before ordering so you know whether one set covers everyone on every shift.

faq.q: Is this a good Nurses Week gift for a whole unit?
faq.a: Yes, that is the main appeal. A set of 25 lets a manager or coworker give everyone on a team something small and personal.

faq.q: Would this work for a nursing graduation?
faq.a: It would work well for a small class or a group of new grads, especially paired with a congratulations card.
